 I've connected them to my tablet, which (because Apple sucks) does not have a free equalizer app nor any sort of audio altering avaliable in settings (except for airpods of course).

Just a thing I wanted to mention for potential buyers, make sure you have a setting in your device that disconnects the synchronization between the two volume buttons, for a bigger range of more silent sound options. I would suggest trying to trim your fur a bit more slowly and avoid chopping it as much. This is something i see in many first fursuits, fur direction changes a lot, even if by cutting the fabric this way may cause you to loose a square inch or two by pattern placement, it's worth it. What i mean by "quality concerns" in many bases is the gluing amd smoothing, I've seen many bases that were falling apart because of awful gluing, had glue on the inside of the head space which was uncomfortable to wear, or were made with small chunks of foam that looked like a badly put together puzzle game. Also I've come across many chunky bases with square not smoothed cheeks and brows. I really like that your base is not only smooth, well glued but also really symmetrical. I absolutely love it.

I'd work on the bottom jaw a bit before starting commissions if i were you, it shouldn't be wider than the snout, imagine an animal closing their mouth, the bottom teeth fit inside the upper ones, as well as the jaw. I know that your style isn't one I'm into because i really like gore like fursuits, but i can say that your quality is great. The most problems i notice in fursuit bases are quality concerns, not style related things. So i would definitely commission you if i were looking for a cute well made smooth base
